# DVC: eleven undocumented edits, no test suite to find them

I drive this tool from the command line to keep data under version control and to run reproducible pipelines, and a recent build misbehaves in a scattered set of places. The repository has received 11 separate undocumented edits. Nothing about my projects or my settings changed; what follows is everything I pinned down by observation, and the symptoms look unrelated, so please do not assume one repair covers several of them.

Two things are already wrong before I ask for any work. When a newer release exists, the notice names my version and the available one correctly, but the advice printed underneath about how to move up is wrong for every kind of installation I tried: ones put in through a package manager (pip, conda, brew, choco, deb-based, rpm-based) are told to uninstall and reinstall from the website instead of being handed that manager's own upgrade command; the standalone installer flavours — the macOS package, the Windows executable, the plain binary — get the generic "find the latest release at ..." line that belongs to the other case; and where the installation method is unknown or was never detected, that generic pointer is what should appear and the uninstall-and-reinstall wording appears instead.
